# Full Statutory Corpus: MT

## Mont. Code Ann. § 15-30-2103: Rate of Tax - Net Income
`MCA > Title 15 > Chapter 30 > Part 21 > § 15-30-2103`

### English
Imposes restructured individual income tax with two brackets at 4.7% and top rate 5.9% under SB 399 in Montana.

### Español
Impone impuesto individual reestructurado con dos tramos al 4.7% y tasa máxima del 5.9% bajo SB 399 en Montana.
